pages.en:
c/o Royal Canadian Mounted Police,
Saskatoon, Sask., Canada.
September 6, 1937.

The Chief Constable,
British City Police,
SHANGHAI, China.

Dear Sir:

I attach hereto a letter addressed to
my sister, Mrs. Anita Idem-eller, whose last address
known to me is: Lyon House, 127, Room 16, Bubbling
Well, Road 701, Shanghai, and at which address she
has resided for a year or more. The last letter re-
ceived from her was dated July 12, which is before the
outbreak of the present trouble in China and you will
readily understand that I am greatly worried about
her, as she has been in the habit of writing to me
weekly and since that date her letters have ceased.

In order to facilitate your enquiries
in regard to my sister's whereabouts, I may add that
in her last letter to me she stated that she intended
going to KAO CHIACO, for a month. She also has a friend
Mrs. J.P. MARSH, 630- Rue de Seiyees, Shanghai, who may
be able to give some information about her. A woman
by the name of Mrs. Lebanson (I am not quite certain
of the right spelling) was supposed to have gone with
her to KAO CHIACO. This is all the information I am able
to give. I am very anxious to have her come to stay with
me, if she is willing to leave, but until I know where
to locate her, no definite plan can be made, and I am
taking this means of getting in touch with her.

Anything you can do for me by way of getting
me in communication with my sister, and advising me
regarding her well-being, will be greatly appreciated.

Yours truly,
(Miss) I. Rose

i.o., I am employed as
secretary with the R.C. M.Police
for many years, and have been ad-
vised to communicate with you in
regard to locating my sister.

I.R.

转交：加拿大皇家骑警，
萨斯喀彻温省，萨斯卡通，加拿大。
1937年9月6日。

致：
中国上海，
英国市警察局，
警察局长。

尊敬的先生：

随函附上一封给我妹妹安妮塔·伊德梅勒夫人（Mrs. Anita Idem-eller）的信。据我所知，她最近的地址是：上海静安寺路701号，里昂公寓127号16室，她在此已居住一年有余。我收到她的最后一封信日期为7月12日，那是在中国当前事变爆发之前。您不难理解，我对她深感担忧，因为她惯于每周给我写信，但自该日期以来，她的信件便中断了。

为便于您查询我妹妹的下落，我补充说明：在她给我的最后一封信中，她表示打算前往高家桥（KAO CHIACO）一个月。她在上海还有一位朋友J.P.马什夫人（Mrs. J.P. MARSH），住址为西爱咸斯路630号（630- Rue de Seiyees），她或许能提供有关我妹妹的一些信息。据称有一位名为莱班森夫人（Mrs. Lebanson，拼写我不太确定）的女子与她一同前往高家桥（KAO CHIACO）。这是我能提供的所有信息。如果她愿意离开，我非常希望她能来与我同住，但在查明她的下落之前，无法制定任何确切计划，因此我采取此方式试图与她取得联系。

若您能协助我与妹妹取得联系，并告知我她的安危状况，我将不胜感激。

此致，
I. 罗斯小姐（(Miss) I. Rose）

附注：我在加拿大皇家骑警担任秘书多年，经人建议就查找我妹妹一事与您联系。

I.R.
